apps.localizedDescription:
Note: Notifications may not work for some devices

Features:

•Screenshot Supression - Screenshotting will no longer send a notification.

• Keep Snaps In Chat - Delivered and open snaps will temporarily be saved in chat.

• Story Ghost - View stories anonymously.

• Snap Ghost - Snaps and messages will appear unviewed/unopened.

• Spoof Story Views

• Spoof Story Screenshots

• Save To Camera Roll - Tap and hold while viewing a snap to bring up the UI press "Save Snap"

• Hide Subtitle - Hide the subtitle containing an MOTD or something from the devs

• Upload From Camera Roll - Press the upload button to select an image and then press the button to take a picture.

• Hide Call Buttons - Hide the call buttons on recent Ul versions.

• Video Call Confirm - Presents a popup to verify that the action was intentional.

• Audio Call Confirm - Presents a popup to verify that the action was intentional.

• Hide New Chat Button - Hide the blue button on the bottom on recent Ul versions.

• Remove Highlights (Not Working) - Remove the stupid TikTok knock-off tab (requires app restart).

• Hide Friendmoji - Hide the "Friendmojis" next to people's names (requires pull-refresh).

• Randomize Best Friends - Randomly change the order off the best friends list.

• Keep Normal Title - Enable this to hide the "Shadow X" label

• Cool RGB Animation - Makes the shadow header RBG (think chromahomebarx).
